method: Full decoded skinned vertex comparison after identical paused clip seeks at baseYaw 0 and pi. Seven poses include active slide hand support and bilateral get_up hand support, with independently validated anatomical skin/glove triangles and positive actual ground/anchor observations. Those two poses advance an equal1/120s step at each heading to require actual solver execution; their sample clocks must match. Baseline world vertices are independently rotated 180 degrees about the world origin. Actor state is reset through paused seek; source sampler, solver and post-IK floor code are unchanged. Public actor inspection changes only heading/offset state.
limitations: Seven static poses per selected identity and LOD; not every heading or stateful transition.
Grouping uses largest skin weight, not an anatomical segmentation. Rest-Y bins use original decoded POSITION.y.
Vertices shared across split material primitives are counted separately.
A partial diagnostic can remain valid for its exact served offline payload while raw source GLBs are being exported; complete/pass still require all disk guards.
No GPU or physical-phone performance measurement.
